name: zenvi
description: Edit videos with Zenvi from Claude Code: import footage, cut and arrange it, add titles, transitions, effects and music, look at frames, render, then open the result in the Zenvi app or share a web editor link. Drives After Effects and Premiere Pro through the Zenvi Link extension, hands edits between Zenvi, Adobe apps, Remotion and HyperFrames, and applies a motion-design taste guide.
